## Notes

- Strafing Table, 40.8, chart page 5 (jp2 99). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 5): 0 of 40 cells differ.
- columns are the TacAir points strafing one target (pilot ratings not added, 40.61). dice is the two-dice range read in order (11 to 66) that gives the row's result in that column; null where the column has no such result.
- shifts: one column right against trucks in convoy or a supply dump; infantry one column left in a fortification level 0 or 1 hex, two in level 2; armour one column left in a level 2 hex. Shifts are printed under the chart only.
- result means, by target: trucks, truck points lost with their cargo; infantry, TOE strength points lost with any trucks carrying them; supply dump, tenths of every kind of supply in the dump; pipeline, destroyed on 2 or 3; grounded aircraft, dice rolled, their sum the aircraft destroyed; armour, dice rolled, their sum the minimum armour protection points lost. Strafing a port only adds to a bombing of that port (40.66).
